page.overview:
What is Mega Absol Z?

Upon Mega Evolution, Absol's appearance doesn't change much except for larger and more curved horns. It's white fur grows fluffier and longer around its ankles. When Absol Mega evolves, the fur on its back stiffens up and grows out, giving it the appearance of angelic wings. It can glide on the winds, but it lacks the ability to fly.

For Mega Absol Z, its once-white coat deepens into a rich, shadowy navy, and the fur on the left side of its face grows long enough to veil its left eye entirely. Its skin lightens into a muted steel-blue tone that gives it a cooler, ghostlike presence. The marking on its forehead sharpens into a rounded triangular emblem, echoing the symbol of its other Mega state but with a slightly more refined slope. The trademark sickle horn fractures into a sharper, zig-angled form, like a lightning bolt frozen in place. The smaller horn atop its head, the spurs behind its legs, and its tail follow this same aesthetic, becoming more rigid and angular than the softer shapes seen on standard Mega Absol. Its claws straighten out as well, looking 'leaner, longer, and precise, reforged for surgical strikes. On the left side of its neck ruff, three short tufts of fur flare outward, each ending in a crimson tint that stands out against the darker palette. Its right flank is a massive plume of dark navy fur streaked with red, which Mega Absol Z can reshape at will, curling it into grasping, clawlike configurations that move almost like an extra limb.

Shiny Absol's face, tail, claws and oval marking are red instead of dark blue.

Absol is a very good-natured Pokémon that warns people of upcoming disasters by appearing before them. When it is not warning people in nearby cities, it is generally a Pokémon that lives in solitude, and spends its time up in the mountains, much like a big cat. Sometimes it may even help people to guard their fields. Unfortunately, some people misunderstand Absol, seeing it as an omen or cause of disaster.
